**Location Spoofer {VERSION}** — the recommended Windows app.{CHANNEL_NOTE}

### Install
1. Install [**Apple Devices**](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9np83lwlpz9k) from the Microsoft Store (free, made by Apple; iTunes also works).
2. Download **`LocationSpooferStandalone.exe`** below and save it in a folder you own (for example Desktop or Documents).
3. Run it. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info → Run anyway** (the app is not code-signed yet).
4. Follow the setup guide that opens on first run.

Already installed? The app updates itself; press **Restart now** when it offers.

Requires Windows 10/11 (64-bit) with the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (built into Windows 11).
